d: We’re looking for an Arabic-speaking Project Coordinator based in Qatar to support our project team, visiting advertising and editorial staff, and freelance analysts by providing day-to-day coordination and administrative support.

This is a home-based position requiring the successful candidate to be available during working hours and occasionally visit local companies, offices and other organisations to collect or deliver documents and materials as required.
The ideal candidate will be proactive, reliable, well-organised and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, international business environment.
q: Fluency in English and Arabic (spoken and written)
Strong organizational, planning, and multitasking abilities
Good communication skills, strong customer orientation with excellent phone etiquette, able to handle high volume calls
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Proficiency in MS Office and Google Workspace
Experience in project coordination, operations, administrative support, or client service roles is an advantage
Demonstrated ability to adapt quickly to new tools and technologies
To apply, please send your CV and cover letter to hr@oxfordbusinessgroup.com
r: Liaise with the Country Director as required regarding project priorities and ongoing tasks.
Arrange and coordinate meetings, schedules, and appointments.
Assist with communication and follow-ups with local companies, organisations and business contacts.
Provide translation and interpretation during meetings and interviews when needed.
Sign up all persons met/interviewed by advertising/editorial staff for relevant OBG web stories.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date calendars, contact lists, charts and reports.
Arrange travel and accommodation bookings when required.
Provide additional assistance to Analysts when needed.
Coordinate the driver’s schedule and share optimized daily itineraries in advance.
Visit local companies, offices and other organisations to collect or deliver documents, advertising materials, publications or other project-related items when required.
Collect artwork and submit to the head office.
Organise delivery of OBG publications to advertisers and to other designated contacts.
Remain available and responsive via phone, email and other communication channels during working hours, particularly when team members are attending meetings or conducting fieldwork.

Ensure a structured handover at the end of projects or assignments, including full documentation of pending tasks, reports, systems, and processes, making list of the current needs, priorities and issues and ensuring continuity through proper transition support.
Collect all the receipts for every expense, and assists the Country Director with compiling the expense reports.
Liaise with the head office to receive the invoices, proof read invoices and check accuracy, send invoices to clients.
Work with head office to ensure timely collection against invoices - follow up with clients for payment.

d: Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Relationship Manager to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in crypto derivatives and options sales, with a robust book of clients ready to onboard within LATAM market. This role involves global market coverage and targets trading firms, market makers, and other institutional clients.
q: Minimum 5 years of experience in crypto derivatives/options sales.
Proven track record with trading firms, market makers, and other institutional clients.
Strong understanding of global crypto markets and financial instruments.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
r: Proactively hunt and acquire new clients in the crypto derivatives market.
Maintain and grow relationships with existing clients to ensure ongoing business and satisfaction.
Develop and implement effective sales strategies to meet and exceed targets.
Identify and capitalize on new business opportunities within the market.
Stay updated on market trends, competitor activities, and product developments.
Provide feedback to product development teams to enhance product offerings based on client needs.
Collaborate with internal teams, including marketing and product development, to align sales strategies.
Prepare regular reports on sales performance and market insights for management review.
x: At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

d: Emirates NBD is a market leader across the MENAT (Middle East, North Africa and Türkiye) region with a presence in 13 countries, serving over 9 million customers. Emirates NBD is the leading financial services brand in the UAE with a Brand value of approximately USD 4 billion. We serve our customers and help them realise their financial objectives through a range of banking products and services including retail banking, corporate & institutional banking, Islamic banking, investment banking, private banking, asset management, global markets and treasury, and brokerage operations. We are a key participant in the global digital banking industry, with 97% of all financial transactions and requests conducted outside of our branches. We also operate Liv, the lifestyle digital bank by Emirates NBD. With over half a million users, it continues to be the fastest-growing digital bank in the region.
q: University Degree in Business or Finance.
At least 4 years in a sales role within the Financial services/Banking industry.
Experience across a wide range of Banking areas, e.g. Retail and Wealth Management.
Excellent communication and presentation skills. Interpersonal skills are essential for this role.
There’s never been a better time to join Emirates NBD.

We’re one of the region’s most recognisable brands. We’re banking innovation leaders. We’re growing across both the UAE and our global offices. We offer a huge range of professional development opportunities to accelerate your career. It also goes without saying that we provide extremely competitive rewards, benefits and perks too, like our flexible work policy so you can work from home whenever it suits.
At ENBD, we encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for positions that match their skills and capabilities.
r: As a Relationship Manager / Senior Relationship Manager within Priority Banking at Emirates NBD, your role is to responsible for the acquisition of new client relationships for this segment, maintenance and growth of existing client relationships, meeting revenue targets for Assets, Liabilities, Investments and Insurance business, achieve high levels of service standards and maximize client satisfaction and compliance with UAE Central Bank and anti-money laundering regulations.
Builds and develops relationships with Priority Banking clients, while leveraging customer service representatives (CSRs) for basic transactions.
Acquires new clients, presents products, and closes deals to contribute to unit goals.
Offers comprehensive advice on all Priority Banking products, including basic banking, lending, and wealth management.
Proactively contacts clients to cross-sell products and promote new offerings.
Follows all policies related to operational risk, sales practices, and anti-mis-selling.
Keeps client profiles up-to-date, upholds confidentiality, and assesses risk tolerance for suitable product recommendations.
Monitors and improves service quality to exceed client expectations.
Cross-sells and refers clients to other bank areas, staying informed of market trends and competitor activity.
